title: A miner gives its stores at Alpha Centauri Colonial Station: iron, copper and the reserve's ores to the hauler there (docked steel, strict classes)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-24 05:48 UTC: requests.log ENT-486 (Apollo): miners' storage at Alpha Centauri held 11,250 iron ore and 4,082 copper ore (data/stock/storage.json, book of 2026-11-24T05:47:42Z); Apollo names the hauler receiver there (handover.py receivers) and writes the docked steel route. Copied from give-miner-stores-procyon: one stop, docked, the hold stored, then one gift from storage to the hauler. requires.stored: any one of the goods, 50 or more, in the pilot's own storage here; requires.max_jumps 6: only a ship near this station takes it. Orders ENT-085 P2 (iron to steel where it lies), P5; rules F23, F24, F36. 2026-11-24 06:01 UTC (Zero): status off: no hauler receiver is named at this station (data/fleet/receivers.json), so the gift fell to the default hauler of every station; two runs gave 911 iron ore and 271 copper ore into that hauler's storage here (data/stock/handover.jsonl). On again when Apollo names the receiver (requests ENT-486). 2026-11-24 09:37 UTC (Zero): on again: handover.py dry-run names a hauler receiver of this very station (Apollo, requests ENT-495; data/fleet/receivers.json names two Logistics receivers at alpha_centauri_colonial_station); their docked steel route is craft-steel-logistics-alpha-centauri.
